newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria buys up to 275,000 tonnes wheat -traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria buys up to 275,000 tonnes wheat -traders.

text.p: Algeria on Thursday bought up to 275,000 tonnes of wheat, around half of it from the United States, European grain traders said.
Pricing details were still sketchy but several exporters said U.S. hard red winter wheat was priced at between $162 and $163 per tonne, cost and freight.
Algeria also purchased wheat of optional origin at around $160 per tonne, including cost and freight.
